usedFor: tawk.to holds live chats with site visitors, and Calendly sets up a meeting through “Create One-Time Meeting” once “Chat Ends”.

bestTemplate.name: “Chat Ends” in tawk.to, then “Create One-Time Meeting” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A finished chat is when a visitor is ready to talk, so the action sets up a one-time meeting.

watchOut: Use “Chat Ends” for booking, not “Visitor Starts Chat”, which fires before the visitor has said anything.
